author: Athul Prem
scope: The saved left-incidence columns compare the 200 and 160 nm target body meshes at 1 GHz with the same nominal fixed-property cubic Ge, 26-hole polygonal geometry and ports. The pair fails both 0.01 mesh sensitivity criteria. Right-incidence response, full scattering-matrix unitarity, and full-device reciprocity are outside this comparison.
time_convention: exp(-i*omega*t); port forces use the +x normal at both ends
complex_encoding: Every complex value is represented by [real, imaginary]. Reflection and transmission blocks use rows for outgoing roots and columns for incoming roots, as stored at each level.

port_geometry.scope: Shared 99-DOF P2 trace discretization. Coordinates and component indices order every saved port shape. The saved mass matrix can be used to normalize the gauge overlaps.

thickness_layer_diagnostics.scope: Counts read from the two saved affine volume meshes. A near-hole tetrahedron has a centroid within 100 nm in radial distance from the nearest ideal cylindrical wall. Wall and bulk mesh sizes changed together.

comparison.author: Athul Prem
comparison.scope: Fixed geometry and ports at 1 GHz. Left-incident columns only.
comparison.basis_convention: When fine input and output bases equal coarse bases times A and B, respectively, compare B S_fine A^(-1) in the coarse gauge.
